name: Input Buffer
description: Remembers early clicks for 2-8 frames and uses them the moment you can jump.

extra-frames.name: Buffer Window (frames)
extra-frames.description: How early (in 60 FPS frames) you can click before landing or reaching an orb and still have the click count. The click is used once, never as an extra jump.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Runs levels in test mode so completions and percentages aren't saved while the buffer is on.
